rollback_evidence: Live write and return on Nexus 9000v 9.3(12) (2026-11-23): On a pair member without vPC roles the peer-link was assigned to an idle trunk port-channel and, in a second run, removed from it; each was read back by the check identity and undone. NX-OS removes the spanning-tree port type with no vpc peer-link, so the removal writes spanning-tree port type network back. Assigns or removes the local peer-link on a preconfigured, idle trunk with spanning-tree port type network. Refuses a domain with vPC member ports.
